about.content: I build web applications and backend systems designed for speed, reliability, and clear user workflows. My work spans the full stack: responsive user interfaces with Next.js and TypeScript, real-time messaging with WebSockets, and database modeling with PostgreSQL and MongoDB.\n\nI focus on predictable application state, well-documented APIs, and clean code that teams can maintain and scale with confidence.

hero.quote: Building fast, dependable full-stack applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.
